entities.name: Ivan Franjo Jukić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivan Franjo Jukić was a Bosnian writer and Franciscan friar from Bosnia and Herzegovina, whose life and cultural and political legacy have left an indelible mark on the cultural history of the country, where he is remembered as one of the founders of Bosnian modernism. He mainly wrote under the pseudonym Slavoljub Bošnjak.
